protocol.initial_service: empty, matching live scheduling dispatcher reset; prefix tokens still prepaid
limitations: Fixed outputs/service times; no new live latency or quality evidence.
Three already seen cases, historical code and prompt versions differ; mechanism study only.
Local tool/verification/handoff time omitted; zero-spacing admission uses listed group/node order.
Exact recorded DAG remaining count differs from live five-call upper bound.
Replay guard and runtime guard differ on unaffordable response fallback; equivalence not established.
Complete means model DAG executed, not semantic success; native scores reported separately.
Two budget caps test token affordability, not sustained arrival-rate overload.
No final-set access, provider requests, operational writes, or cherry-picked retries.
Queue metrics cover dispatched calls only; rejected ready-call waiting is unmeasured.
FIFO admission limit one; no deadline preemption or guarantee of full-workflow affordability. Admission waiting counts from original arrival.
Both foreground orders are included as sensitivity conditions; order is not chosen by shortest actual duration.
